title: MKL_NUM_THREADS=40 aborts ABACUS LCAO before the first SCF iteration (Inverse_Matrix range_error)
symptom: Four fresh MnF2 SCF jobs died before the first electronic iteration with std::range_error at Inverse_Matrix.hpp:117 (source_lcao/module_ri); the eigensolver return codes were 559/661/763 on the first calls.
root_cause: The new submission script set MKL_NUM_THREADS=40 where the historical ABACUS scripts set 1; the LCAO inverse-matrix path is not safe under that threading on this build. The only changed variable was the thread count.
minimal_fix: Set MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 for the ABACUS stage (matching the historical scripts) and resubmit; all four cases then completed. If threading is desired, validate the exact (build, threads) pair on a small case first.
validation: Job 3286634 (nb128) completed after the single-variable revert; the other three points likewise.
avoid: Raising thread counts inside ABACUS LCAO stages without a small-case validation; confusing this with the LibRPA-side OMP layout rules (which are separate).

parameters.MKL_NUM_THREADS: 1 for ABACUS LCAO stages on this build
